question: Q-N-M1-D3
text: Distinct OD pairs served by each vendor, 2023 vs 2024.
interpretation: Distinct OD pairs served by each vendor, 2023 vs 2024.
assemble: SELECT vendor_id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2023 THEN distinct_od_pairs END), 0) AS distinct_od_pairs_2023, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_year = 2024 THEN distinct_od_pairs END), 0) AS distinct_od_pairs_2024 FROM q WHERE trips > 0 GROUP BY vendor_id ORDER BY vendor_id
note: A vendor with no trips in a year has zero distinct pairs, as COUNT(DISTINCT) over no rows.
